purpose: A production contract for learner-facing source encounters. It protects accuracy, context, and the difference between study and personal ruling.

fields.reference: Exact work, chapter, folio, or section; a stable primary-text link where available.
fields.primaryText: Quoted Hebrew/Aramaic text, its edition or source, and any editorial normalization.
fields.translation: Plain-English translation tagged as literal, guided, or paraphrase; paraphrase must be marked.
fields.genre: Torah, Mishnah, Gemara, prayer, halakhic code, philosophy, history, or ethical text.
fields.learnerLevel: The assumed reading and conceptual background required for this encounter.
fields.learningObjective: One observable reading or reasoning move, not a vague topic label.
fields.prerequisiteSkillIds: Skill-graph IDs required to make the intended move.
fields.languageSupport: Glosses, transliteration policy, grammar note, and an accessible translation path.
fields.context: Speaker, setting, source relationship, and interpretive limits needed for a fair reading.
fields.assessment: One defensible best answer, rationale, plausible misconceptions, and a transfer or retrieval prompt.
fields.safetyBoundary: States when the encounter explains a text rather than gives personal halakhic, medical, or pastoral advice.
fields.review: Second source context, retrieval date or trigger, reviewer initials, and review status.
